1.consolidated_definition: Grabadora o radio portátil que se usa con audífonos. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Armado con un walkman, que invariablemente reproducía la canción Satellite of love de Lou Reed, observaba la ciudad y sus habitantes como si formaran parte de un video musical (El Nuevo Día, 06-07-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Portable cassette player or radio used with headphones. Raw anglicism, commonly used. Equipped with a walkman, which invariably played the song Satellite of Love by Lou Reed, it observed the city and its inhabitants as if they were part of a music video (The New Day, 06-07-06)
